transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. 

Um, I guess what finally made me come in today is that I just keep forgetting basic adult things. Like, I'll forget to pay my bills, or I won't return interview emails. I keep missing appointments and just... not following through on regular errands. It's gotten to the point where it's really starting to cost me real opportunities, so I figured I needed to finally talk to someone about it.
Have you struggled with these difficulties with organization and follow-through since you were a child, or is this a more recent change in your life?

It's definitely been since I was a kid. Um, even back in elementary school, my teachers would always write notes on my report cards saying that I was bright, but... I constantly lost my worksheets. I would rush through directions, talk out of turn, and my desk was always so messy I could never actually find my assignments when it was time to turn them in. So, yeah, it's not a recent change at all.
Beyond the trouble with organization, have you been feeling persistently sad, hopeless, or uninterested in things you usually enjoy?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I definitely get frustrated with myself when I mess up or miss out on things, but I don't feel sad or hopeless. And I still really like doing the things I usually enjoy. It's really just the... the stress of not having my life together, not that I feel down all the time.
Do you find that you spend a significant amount of your time feeling uncontrollably worried or anxious about a wide range of different daily life events?

No, I wouldn't say I'm an anxious person overall. Um, I don't just sit around worrying about random daily stuff. 

I definitely get stressed out when I realize I've missed a deadline or messed something up, but... it's not like an uncontrollable worry about everything. It's pretty much just a direct reaction to me dropping the ball on things, not a general anxiety about life.
Do you often feel like you have a lot of excess energy, or find it difficult to sit still for long periods of time?

Yeah, definitely. It's really hard for me to just sit still. Um, whenever I have to sit through something like an interview, a meeting, or... or even just watching a movie, I get this intense pressure inside my body. It feels like I just have to get up, or shift around in my seat, or do something with my hands. If I don't, it honestly feels like I'm going to crawl right out of my skin.

When you look back at your childhood and your current life, would you say that your struggles are primarily driven by having trouble focusing and organizing, or by being overly active and impulsive, or does it feel like a pretty even mix of both?

I'd say it's honestly a pretty even mix of both. Um, looking back, I've always had a really hard time paying attention and keeping things organized, but the physical restlessness and... just doing things without thinking are just as bad. They both cause a lot of problems for me every single day. So, yeah, I can't really pick one over the other—it's definitely both.
